omittedAsset.reason: Insufficient common history for the frozen window; not a performance exclusion.

universe.retainedPriorCoverageFinding: The earlier eight-asset common history was 448 of 955 requested rows; this is coverage evidence only, not a strategy-performance result.

input.timestampPolicy: Strict midnight UTC ISO-8601 Z timestamps in exact daily sequence; no coercion, sorting, forward-fill, repair, substitution, or partial-asset fallback.
input.ohlcPolicy: All seven assets must have identical timestamps and 955 rows. Positive finite OHLC; high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close), high >= low. Volume is finite and nonnegative; trades is a nonnegative integer.
input.hashProvenance: Copied from offline-verification.json. Hashes bind captured bytes only and do not authenticate source, source history, or the caller's in-memory arrays.

diagnostic.label: Historical development/conditioned diagnostic; NOT a holdout.

calendar.segmentReset: Each segment starts at USD 10,000 cash with zero holdings. Feature history carries across the boundary; positions, pending orders, equity, and accounting reset. Each segment liquidates independently.

features.numericFormat: IEEE-754 binary64; fixed asset order; deterministic row and variant order.
features.basketReturn: b[t] = arithmetic mean of the seven simple close returns close[a,t]/close[a,t-1]-1.
features.annualizedVolatility: sigma[n,t] = sample standard deviation of the last n basket returns, denominator n-1, multiplied by sqrt(365).
features.referenceVolatility: m[n,t] = median of the last 365 sigma[n] values, including current t; no interpolation for the odd-length window.
features.exposure: clip(m[n,t]/sigma[n,t], floor, 1). INVALID_SIGNAL if nonfinite or sigma <= 1e-12.

firstSignalIndex.note: Index is zero-based from the first warmup close. The 45-day variant's first median uses the 410th close at 2025-04-03.

features.decisionTiming: A close at row t is known only after that interval closes; a decision uses only rows through t and is filled no earlier than a later row's open.

trading.initialTarget: First segment target uses the previous completed close; its scheduled first fill is at the first segment open, or one day later in the delayed scenario.
trading.weeklyDecision: Each Sunday completed close creates one equal-weight target instruction for the next Monday open; one-day delay fills that same immutable instruction on Tuesday open.
trading.band: Compare raw target to last accepted target; accept iff Math.abs(raw-lastAccepted) >= 0.10 using binary64 with no epsilon. Initial target is accepted. Update lastAccepted at decision time, not fill time.
trading.weeklyRebalance: Every scheduled weekly fill equalizes all seven asset weights to accepted exposure/7, even when the band does not change the target.
trading.idealization: Target-weight-at-open using that open price is idealized execution. It is not a pre-submitted share-quantity order or a claim of executable first-print liquidity; gaps, spreads, impact, lot sizes, minimum sizes, and liquidity are not modeled.
trading.units: Fractional units; no leverage, shorts, interest, or funding.

costAssumptions.base: 85bp per side = 80bp published Kraken Spot Crypto Tier 1 taker reference plus 5bp assumed friction.
costAssumptions.stress: 160bp per side; 160bp plus a one-day fill delay in the third scenario.
costAssumptions.status: Owner approval pending. Tier/reference is not owner-specific, historical, or verified entitlement; 5bp is an assumption, not measured spread or impact.

accounting.rebalance: At fill prices p, V=K+sum(q*p); solve E=V-c*sum(abs(w*E-q*p)); qNew=w*E/p; cashNew=(1-sum(w))*E.
accounting.solver: Bisection on [0,V], at most 100 iterations, tolerance 1e-6 USD.
accounting.validation: Require finite nonnegative weights/units/cash, sum(weights)<=1, positive V, and abs(cashNew+sum(qNew*p)+currentFillCost-V)<=1e-6. Conservation uses the current fill cost, not cumulative historical costs against current V. Failure invalidates the entire batch.
accounting.terminal: At each segment's own final close, independently liquidate all units at close with sale-side costs; include terminal fees in the final daily equity and daily return. Cancel orders beyond the segment horizon without replacement.
accounting.drawdown: Sampled daily-close drawdown only, with initial E0=10,000 included as the first peak. No synchronized intraday drawdown is inferred.
accounting.dailyReturns: Exactly 180 development and 365 diagnostic close-to-close net returns per completed path; E0 precedes the first scored day, so first-day entry fees are included. Delayed day-one remains cash.

order: 5 candidates in declared order x 3 scenarios in declared order x development then diagnostic
Full basket x 3 scenarios x development then diagnostic
Mean-exposure and risk-exposure fixed controls x 3 scenarios x diagnostic only

controls.meanExposure: Arithmetic mean of primary 85bp path's daily held target across 180 development rows; zero before first fill. Not realized weight drift or weekly-only mean.
controls.riskExposure: min(1, sampleSD(primary 85bp development daily net returns)/sampleSD(full-basket 85bp development daily net returns)); sample denominator N-1; zero primary SD maps to zero exposure.
controls.freeze: Derive once from development; use identical frozen values for all diagnostic cost/delay scenarios. Invalid/nonfinite or benchmark SD <= 1e-12 yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and no diagnostic continuation.

pathManifest.benchmarks: Full-basket weekly equal-weight (100%) and cash zero are costed/calendared consistently; static controls weekly equalize exposure/7. No band applies to fixed controls.
pathManifest.identity: Path and execution IDs bind protocol ID/hash, implementation ID/hash, input identity/hash, variant, scenario, and segment. Caller-supplied implementation hash is an identity assertion, not runtime source authentication.

primary: Primary 85bp diagnostic return >= both frozen controls
Primary 85bp diagnostic drawdown <= both frozen controls
(full-basket drawdown-primary drawdown)/full-basket drawdown >= 20%; full-basket drawdown <= 1e-12 is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
Primary diagnostic net return > 0 at 160bp and at 160bp plus one-day delay
screen.neighbours: At least 3 of 4 neighbours have positive diagnostic net return at 85bp and at least 3 of 4 at 160bp; neighbours are sign robustness only, not matched-control claims.
screen.interpretation: PASS is a historical candidate only. No statistical significance, alpha, prospective validation, or fresh holdout claim.

reporting.missingRisk: No finite trade stop exists; trade CRV is explicitly UNDEFINED_NO_FINITE_STOP, null, research-only, and not a promotion failure/default zero.

budget.failure: Any malformed input, calendar/hash identity failure, signal/accounting failure, timeout, output limit, or nondeterministic condition invalidates and stops the whole batch. Preserve completed paths as incomplete evidence; never rank or retry.

limitations: Input source authenticity is not established by offline hashes.
The universe has survivorship/history limitations, including omission of HBAR for coverage only.
Diagnostic rows are historical and conditioned, not a holdout.
The prior eight-asset acquisition failed the coverage target, not a performance test.
No captured price CSV may be loaded or used to calculate features, returns, or PnL during implementation or testing.
